Wrap option disabled preserves long lines without breaking

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"wrap\":false}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>This is a long paragraph that should not be wrapped at all because wrapping is disabled.</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
